summary: Rows reordered by dragging, with a pointer, a finger or the keyboard: Space lifts a row, the arrows move it and Space drops it.

props.name: onItemsChange
props.description: Called with the new order after a drop.

props.name: handle
props.description: Drag by the grip alone, which leaves the rest of the row free for buttons and links. `false` lets the whole row drag.

props.name: numbered
props.description: Numbers each row by its place.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Names the list for screen readers.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the list and its rows. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
